title: Overhyped and Extremely Linty
text:
Overhyped and Extremely Linty. The amount of lint these towels put out, along with shedding, is astounding. Do not even think about washing these with anything else. Horrible quantity of lint...a massive amount.

These towels are also overhyped. While they feel soft to the touch, when you are drying yourself off they don't really feel any softer than most other nice cotton towels. The seller describes these as "extremely soft," but they're not extremely soft when you are drying off.

They absorb a nice amount of water while using, but the lint and shedding makes these towels a complete non-recommended from me. The company says just keep washing them over and over, and eventually the lint and shedding will stop. Sure...I wanna pay so much money for a towel that needs so much pre-washing over and over again just to stop the lint and shedding? And this is assuming they are even right that the lint will stop.

I do not know if all the similar towels made in Imabari are as terrible as these. I certainly hope not, but I think they might be.
